reason: A visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness that converts natural-language requests into interactive ECharts and Mermaid charts or diagrams, with appearance controls and image export.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将自然语言请求渲染为可交互的 ECharts 图表和 Mermaid 图表，并支持外观调整与图像导出。
summaries.en: Render natural-language requests as interactive ECharts charts and Mermaid diagrams in DeepSeek Harness with appearance controls and image export.

capabilities: Renders interactive ECharts, ECharts-GL, and Mermaid visualizations
Accepts declarative JSON chart options and Mermaid diagram source
Renders self-contained HTML with inline CSS and JavaScript in a sandboxed iframe
Exports supported visualizations as PNG or SVG images
